text:
Maya Nguyen: Quick sync — Acme EBR planning for Wed 3/31 11:00am PT. Need slide owners, exec ask, and a short preread. Can we confirm owners by EOD tomorrow?

Priya Shah: I can own onboarding status + migration milestones. Will include migration ETA and outstanding blockers.

Liam Ortiz: I'll take renewal health and usage trends (NRR, MAU, top features). Will pull numbers by Mon.

Sam Becker: I'll own the product demo and enablement asks. Need a 12-15m demo slot.

Maya Nguyen: Exec ask: 2-min ask for Dedicated capacity top-up. @Liam can you quantify cost delta + ROI?

Liam Ortiz: Yup — adding a short slide with delta and projected throughput improvement.

Priya Shah: Draft slide list (will update):
```
1) Executive snapshot (Maya)
2) Onboarding status & blockers (Priya)
3) Usage trends & renewal health (Liam)
4) Product demo + enablement (Sam)
5) Risk & mitigation (Maya/Liam)
6) Asks & next steps (Maya)
```

Maya Nguyen: Action items (quick):
- Priya: onboarding slide (due Tue 3/30 EOD)
- Liam: usage + cost delta slide (due Tue 3/30 EOD)
- Sam: demo script + recording link (due Tue noon)
- Maya: assemble deck + send exec preread (once slides in)

Sam Becker: Noted. Can someone paste the latest enablement Looms? I want to reference the new runbook.

Priya Shah: I'll add links to recordings + relevant support tickets. Also capturing top 3 feature asks from customer feedback.

Liam Ortiz: Quick flag: renewal risk — usage down ~18% last 30d, spike in support tickets during the migration window. Outreach scheduled with AE tomorrow. Marking as medium risk until we show recent fixes.

Maya Nguyen: Good call. Add mitigation slide: timeline for fixes + customer comms cadence.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Acme EBR" Wed 2026-03-31 11:00am PT — invite sent to stakeholders.

Maya Nguyen: Final ask — please drop your completed slides into the shared folder and post the deck link here by Tue 3/30 12:00pm PT so I can prepare the preread email. I'll do a 20-min rehearsal Wed 9am PT if needed.

Liam Ortiz: Will do.

Priya Shah: On it.

Sam Becker: Will upload demo notes + recording by Tue noon.

Maya Nguyen: Thanks team :thumbsup:
